about: Liveries of the Daytona USA Hornet for SEGA Rally 3, built by daytona_car.py --livery <key> into a livery store (<store>\<key>\: the car files + manifest.json); hornet_livery.ps1 switches between them. Titles are what the renders show (number, colours). Rows are Daytona USA object rows (docs/kb/daytona_usa_rom_data.md section 11).
